title: Production Tool document (CLAN shared/data.yaml), contract 3
description: The source of truth for one project; the canvas, the editors and today's panels render it. snake_case. Every entity list is a map keyed by the entity's id (its `id` repeats the key), so a patch can name one leaf of one entity and two people never rewrite each other's work (contracts/collab.md). Every entity carries v and field_v. Order is rank, never position. Live text (shot action and direction, beat, scene and note words) lives in Yjs fragments, and checkpoint() alone writes its flat copies here. Bytes are never inline. A v2 document is refused, never read (features/contract-v3.clan).

client_id.description: The client (library shelf) the project is for.

upstream.description: What this project was spun off from (os-layer §5.2): data.upstream.<document_id>, written by the host and read-only (a patch under it is refused, napkin-host ops/edit.rs).

texts.description: Texts written on the canvas (features/canvas-text.clan, 2026-10-16): each holds its words and the canvas element it is, so a node a text is linked into reads its words without the canvas. Optional: a document made before it has none.

v.description: The entity's version: every applied patch batch that touches it adds one (PatchBus).

field_v.description: For each leaf written since the entity was created, the entity version that wrote it, keyed by the leaf's path inside the entity with '/' between parts (camera/size, edl/edl_X/pick/current). A set whose base_version is older than its leaf's field_v is a conflict.

prose.description: A live-text fragment as ProseMirror JSON (clan-store/src/text/extensions.ts), at most 64 KB serialised. hydrate() rebuilds the fragment from it on another device. Written only by checkpoint() from the entity's live-text fragment (contracts/collab.md); a patch to it is refused (owned_by_text).

textProblem.description: Set by checkpoint() when live text overflows its flat field: the field keeps its last valid value, and job starts for the entity refuse with these words.

pick.description: Which version is current, and which are kept beside it (Keep both: ui-behaviour 3.20). A restore is a new pick decision.

libraryCopy.description: Set when this came from, or was published to, the team library: the version this project holds. A copy, never a live link.

handsOff.description: Crew who leave this alone: a person pressed Keep mine on their suggestion, so later jobs of theirs skip it.

window.description: A note's time window in whole seconds (ui-behaviour 3.13): default [floor(t)-1, ceil(t)+1], clamped, at least 2 s, never across a cut. noteWindow() in clan-store/src/time.ts and relay/time_rules.py (examples/windows.json). The time basis follows the note's target: take time for a note on a take (target.kind take, written from the take player), shot time otherwise; clan-store noteToTakeWindow maps either onto the take (features/clip-moment-edit.clan).

asset.description: One file the project uses, keyed by its hash. Bytes are never inline.

locations.description: Where to find the bytes, in resolution order: idb://sha256/<hex>, s3://<bucket>/assets/<hex>, then our https URL.

board.description: An art board: an Excalidraw frame with a purpose (ui-behaviour 3.2).

source.description: A Brand board made from a brand book: the Document it reads.

sketch.description: A ratio-locked sketch area (ui-behaviour 3.7). Its strokes stay on the canvas.

script.description: A script. Its text lives in its scenes, shots and beats; its order in their ranks.

scene.description: A scene of a script. Its fragment (scenes/<id>) holds only script text no shot owns yet.

text.description: The scene's unplanned text, flat. Written only by checkpoint() from the entity's live-text fragment (contracts/collab.md); a patch to it is refused (owned_by_text).

storyboard.description: A storyboard: shots in rank order. A script drives it through a link.

implicit.description: Planned straight from a script for a Video (ui-behaviour 3.5): owned by the Video, with no canvas node until it is shown. Its shots are that Video's timeline, shown and edited in the Video editor. Make a storyboard from these shots clears it and puts the node on the canvas.

video_id.description: The Video whose own shot list this is (decided 2026-10-15): set when the shots were planned straight from the script into that Video. With implicit it needs no renders link; shown as a node, deleting the node puts the shots back in the Video (implicit again) instead of deleting them.

shot.description: One shot of a storyboard. Camera, duration, rank and status are single-value fields; action, direction and the refs come from its live text (shots/<id>).

kind.description: end_card: the last clip, edited like any shot (Graphic · Static).

action.description: What happens. Written only by checkpoint() from the entity's live-text fragment (contracts/collab.md); a patch to it is refused (owned_by_text).

direction.description: Performance direction. Written only by checkpoint() from the entity's live-text fragment (contracts/collab.md); a patch to it is refused (owned_by_text).

refs.description: What the shot's text mentions, by id: a ref (one look, @maya_laughing) or a key (the whole character, @maya: its front and up to 3 other views). Written only by checkpoint() from the entity's live-text fragment (contracts/collab.md); a patch to it is refused (owned_by_text).

direction_condensed.description: Dex's condensed direction for models that read 1,000 characters (Veo 3.1). Written only by Dex's job; read-only to people.

beat.description: A timed row inside a shot (ui-behaviour 3.10): a moment, a line, VO, music, a sound or a camera change. Its words live in beats/<id>.

moment_id.description: A line tied to a moment: moving either writes both in one batch.

text.description: The beat's words. Written only by checkpoint() from the entity's live-text fragment (contracts/collab.md); a patch to it is refused (owned_by_text).

frame.description: A still version: a storyboard frame (shot_id), a frame made from a sketch area (sketch_id), a size of a format set (size_id), or a version of a picture on the canvas (node; features/edit-canvas-pictures.clan).

node.description: The canvas picture (its pic or gen node id) this is a version of. v1 is kind original: the picture as it was before its first edit.

picked_at.description: A canvas picture's version: when it was made or picked. The picture shows its version with the latest picked_at (ties: the higher version).

kind.description: original: v1 of a canvas picture (node), the picture as it was on the canvas; no crew made it.

edits.description: The image editor's non-destructive op list that made an edited frame.

cropped_to.description: The model's output was not exactly the ratio, so it was centre-cropped ('1344×756 · cropped to 16:9').

take.description: A clip version of a shot. A spliced take lists its segments. Never deleted to make room.

kind.description: A mock take is labelled everywhere and never counts as final.

quality.description: The level the take was made at (features/clip-quality.clan), so a draft and a final are never confused: the relay's Job.quality, or for an edit that keeps the clip's size, its source take's. Absent on takes from before quality existed.

size.description: The size it was asked at, as its card says it ("360p", "1080p", "2K").

by.description: Who set the window's ends (features/connected-video.clan): prompt (the take prompt's planned cut times), detected (the relay's take_cuts found the cut), human (a person moved it). Absent: a spliced take's segments, as before.

end.description: The frame the take was made to land on (features/connected-video.clan): next_storyboard, the next shot's storyboard frame (frame_id), sent as the clip's last frame on a continue join; none, no last frame. An end-framed take is retimed whole into its slot (stitch fit speed), never cut from its head. Absent: none.

at_s.description: Where in the take it reached that frame (the job's landS): the clip is used up to and including the frame at at_s, retimed into its slot, and what the model made after it is left out.

score.description: How closely that frame matches the one given (the job's landScore, SSIM).

video.description: A video (the cut): its items in rank order, each with its picked take, and its ad renders.

quality.description: The project's default quality for this video's clips (features/clip-quality.clan); a send may pick another. Absent: standard.

additionalProperties.description: One item of the cut: a shot's clip or a bridge.

seam.description: The join into this item from the one before (features/connected-video.clan). kind: continue (same setup, the action carries on: the clip before may land on this one's frame), cut (a new angle or place), match (a new angle on the same moment; a plain cut for now), dissolve or dip (asked-for transitions, over s seconds). by: crew (Dex set it quietly from scene and camera) or human (a person changed it on the gap chip). Absent: a cut set by nobody. Ignored on the first item.

join.description: How shots join (features/connected-video.clan, behind flags.connectedVideo): film (As one film: Make clips plans runs of takes and landing frames) or shots (Shot by shot: each clip alone, as before). Absent: film where the flag is on.

runs.description: The runs Make clips planned (features/connected-video.clan): the shots made together and how. shot_ids: the run's shots in order. mode: take (one generation of them all), take_refs (one generation from references, no frame), frames (a clip per shot, landing on the next frame on continue joins) or alone. model: the clip model it runs on. state: planned, running, done or failed. job_id: the take's job (take and take_refs). planned_by: crew (Dex's plan) or human (a person's join change re-planned it).

render.description: An ad render of a video: a version Edie made.

review.description: A note on a frame, take, render, ref or video; with a region it is a box, with at_s it has a window. Its words live in reviews/<id>.

text.description: The note's words. Written only by checkpoint() from the entity's live-text fragment (contracts/collab.md); a patch to it is refused (owned_by_text).

link.description: A link between two nodes (ui-behaviour 3.4): the only record of drives, renders, inputs, brand and master. Allowed by common linkRule.

key.description: A solid reference key: one character, place or object. Its refs are its variants.

ref.description: A named reference: key_variant and what it holds for its role (refRoleTable payload: image, swatches, font, rule or document).

document.description: A Document node: a file Nell reads, used as context once linked (ui-behaviour 3.18).

text.description: A text on the canvas (the Text tool's). Its words follow the canvas: an edit there rewrites them; a delete takes it out with its links. Linked into a node (role note), its words are that node's input words.

node.description: The canvas element that is this text.

words.description: What it says, as typed (lines joined by newlines).

format_set.description: A Format set: a master adapted to every format of a pack or a campaign plan (ui-behaviour 3.19; features/campaign-formats.clan). It shows on the canvas as a Campaign board. Its sizes are their own entities.

id.description: The entity's id, or for a picture the canvas node's id (common id or sceneId).

master.description: What every size is made from. picture: a picture on the canvas (its id is the canvas node's id). asset, w and h: the master's picture when the set was made (a video's: its render); protect and crop boxes are in these pixels, and a size made from another asset is out of date.

plan.description: What was asked for in Make all sizes: one pack (kind pack, its pack id) or a campaign plan (kind plan, format-packs.json plans), with the film lengths asked for (30 → 15 and 6 by default).

protect.description: What must stay in every size, asked once per master (Wren: 'What must stay in every size?'). boxes: a still master's, in its pixels. takes: a film's, per take (keyed by take id), in the take's pixels. keep_middle: the person chose no box; crops keep the middle. Changing it puts the crop sizes out of date, nothing else.

copy.description: The words every size lays out as type layers (Edit type): the brand line, legal and the supers. Drawn by the relay and stitch, never sent to a model. A size's own words are in its layers.

reframes.description: A film's shots made again for a shape (phase 6), keyed <take id>@<w>x<h> (the size's shape): Aleph 2's outpaint of the take (new edges, at the nearest of its ratios; 4:5 at 3:4), or Remake for vertical (the shot made again at the shape on a model that carries its characters). Each is its own paid job; every size of that shape that keeps the shot uses it. Added 2026-10-16 (additive).

asset.description: The clip it made, once landed.

size.description: One size of a format set: the format's values copied at creation, how it is made and where it stands (features/campaign-formats.clan). A tile on the Campaign board.

status.description: making: its job runs. ready. look: Jude flagged it (needs a look). stale: what it was made from changed (Update sizes). Absent: not made yet (its method waits for a later build).

locked.description: Locked: Update sizes, Redo and a new master never change it.

from_asset.description: The master's asset it was made from: when the master's is another, the size is out of date ('Master changed · N out of date').

crop.description: The part of the master it shows, in the master's pixels: the subject-aware crop, or the person's (Adjust crop).

crop_by.description: person: Adjust crop set it, so Update sizes keeps it.

plate.description: The size's picture before its type layers (the relay's resize result plate): Edit type draws on it again for free, without making the picture again, and Export at full size upscales it. Added 2026-10-16 (phase 4, additive).

full.description: The delivery-size file Export at full size made (Magnific's upscale of the plate, the type drawn again at full size), kept so a second export spends nothing. Out of date when the plate or the type changed since (from differs from plate). Added 2026-10-16 (phase 4, additive).

from.description: The size's asset (the typed preview) it was made for.

scale.description: Magnific's scale; absent when the plate was only scaled (Magnific cannot take a side under 300 px).

layers.description: This size's changes to the type layers (Edit type), by layer.

edl.description: A cutdown's edit: windows of the same takes in cut order (connected-video's in/out shape), each with its crop for a re-aspect.

crop_keys.description: A slow pan (phase 6): the crop at points through the window (at 0: in, 1: out), in the take's pixels. Wins over crop. Added 2026-10-16 (additive).

crop_by.description: person: Adjust crop on the clip tile set it (a still box). Added 2026-10-16 (additive).

take_size.description: The take's pixels, which crop and crop_keys are in. Added 2026-10-16 (additive).

beats.description: A cutdown's beat plan (Dex, phase 5), shown before it renders: every shot of the master in cut order, kept or dropped, with his reason. Keep or drop on the plan changes the edl. Added 2026-10-16 (additive).

by.description: person: kept or dropped by a person against Dex's plan.

checks.description: Jude's per-format checks, by check; they never block. Ignore is recorded on the check.

check.description: Jude's check of a result against the shot or the brand rules. Brand rules never block; Ignore is recorded here.

ask.description: An agent's question on a node (ui-behaviour 3.17). Its key is question.id; a job's ask copies Job.question (minted by the relay), and the relay decides which answer won. kind is question.kind.

items.description: Every answer in order: the first settled it; a later one is a Change.

suggestion.description: Skye's proposed words on a scene, shot or beat, shown inline until Keep or Keep mine (ui-behaviour 3.10). Nothing changes until Keep.

base_hash.description: The hash of the target's prose the suggestion was written against: a different hash makes it stale.

duration_s.description: A shot's new length, applied on Keep in the same step (features/script-editor.clan).

new_beats.description: Beats Keep adds to the target shot in the same step.

spin_in.description: A spin-in from Brief Maker or Research waiting on Bring in (ui-behaviour 3.18).

job.description: One job, written at submit and patched as it moves; mirrors the relay ledger.

purpose.description: What the job is for, in the app's words (it was ProjectUi.jobCtx).

items.description: One thing a job used (the send tray's rows): what it was, which link brought it, what it was used as, and whether it was ticked.

stale.description: Something out of date because what it was made from changed.
